cohort: 212,101 term singleton births in Sweden between 2006 and 2015
finding: The risk of adverse perinatal outcomes was consistent across proportions of the population but differed across various birth weight centile thresholds on different growth charts.
birth_weight: SGA (<10th centile) prevalence: 10.1% (population chart), 10.0% (customised chart), 3.1% (Intergrowth chart); LGA (>90th centile) prevalence: 10.0% (population chart), 8.2% (customised chart), 25.1% (Intergrowth chart)
